steps.text: Same fix as the first game: it asks for a small fullscreen mode Wine's Mac driver cannot switch to, so Wine emulates the mode change for this executable and scales the window to the screen. Unverified for this game (highball#67 reported a freeze on DXVK and 5 fps on Wine's own Direct3D on the default engine); the first game runs at 60 fps with it.

knownIssues.symptom: Freezes on DXVK after the first frame, runs at about 5 fps on Wine's own Direct3D (reported on the default engine, highball#67)
knownIssues.cause: not measured; the same fullscreen mode request the first game makes is the first suspect
